description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'GatewayAuthenticationProviderUnavailableException' used to indicate that the authentication provider was unavailable. It extends 'DittoRuntimeException' and includes methods for creating instances from message strings or JSON objects, as well as an internal builder class for constructing instances with specific properties.

classes.name: GatewayAuthenticationProviderUnavailableException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception thrown when the authentication provider is unavailable, extending 'DittoRuntimeException' and implementing 'GatewayException'. It contains static methods for instantiation and a nested builder class for constructing instances with custom data.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new mutable builder instance for constructing the exception.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Constructs an exception instance from a message string and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an exception instance from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with the specified headers, copying other properties from the current exception.
